_about: Reviewed question-integrity decisions. factGroups: questions that test the SAME underlying fact (or where one gives away the other's answer). Only one member of a group may ever appear in Daily DIAL IN; Unlimited and Battles treat the group as one question. quarantine: questions that must not be scheduled (reason given). reworded: unpublished questions whose wording was tightened. Reviewed 2026-11-26 (editorial review of every question and statement; not an external source check).
